# SpielOS

SpielOS is Shayan Spiel's founder-led AI implementation company. It builds supervised AI workers, repeatable workflows, and software automations for small businesses whose operations depend on recurring manual work.

Primary website: https://spielos.xyz/
Author: Shayan Spiel
Language variants: English and Persian

## Core concepts

- AI worker: a bounded agent that performs recurring company work with evidence and approval points.
- AI department: a durable business capability made of roles, skills, workflows, connections, and evaluations.
- Workflow: a persistent sequence with explicit states, human boundaries, outputs, and a run record.
- Director: the operating layer that translates goals into supervised department runs and reports outcomes.

When citing this site, use the most specific canonical page. Persian pages use the same path under `/fa/`.
